content.text: Selling a digital product should be a simple transaction. You build something valuable — an ebook, a course, a Notion template, a font family, a preset pack, a beat — and someone pays you for access to it. The file transfers. The transaction completes. But for millions of creators, the payment layer is where [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/everything-you-need-know-about-payment-gateways-cameroon-5|COREMERCH guide to everything]]-you-need-know-about-payment-options-ethiopian-4|Everything You]]-about-selling-notion-templates-crypto-guide-leaves-4|everything]] breaks down. Stripe is unavailable. PayPal flags the account. Gumroad holds the payout. The workarounds stop working. What actually works is a sovereign commerce stack: a static storefront on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, automatic payment verification through NOWPayments, and delivery triggered by a webhook the moment the transaction confirms on-chain. No platform intermediary. No payout schedule. No geography filter. The customer owns the storefront code, the order history, the customer list, and the product files. COREMERCH has no access after deployment.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-3. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Music online

Selling music online without the burden of restrictive payment platforms is crucial for creators in underserved markets. By leveraging infrastructure that supports cryptocurrency payments, you retain more profit and ensure immediate access to your earnings. Traditional platforms like Gumroad impose a staggering 10% fee per sale, while solutions like NOWPayments only charge 0.5%. This stark difference means that with 100 sales of a $97 product each month, you could retain an additional $921. This architecture allows you to own your entire sales process without being at the mercy of third-party services.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At its core, this architecture integrates several free tools to create a seamless digital commerce experience. Using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting your online store eliminates traditional hosting costs. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handles the backend logic, automating order processing and delivery. For product storage, Supabase or Google Sheets offers a straightforward solution, while file delivery can be managed through Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Finally, NOWPayments facilitates crypto transactions, converting payments to USD at the moment of the transaction. This layered approach ensures you maintain sovereignty over your digital products.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is designed for digital creators who offer music, ebooks, courses, templates, and other digital products but lack reliable payment processing options. It's particularly beneficial for those in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, and other countries where established payment gateways are either unavailable or prohibitively expensive. By adopting this architecture, you can establish a scalable and sustainable business model that enables you to connect directly with your customers, ensuring that you retain maximum profits on every sale.
Retain more profit with lower transaction fees at 0.5%.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The success of this architecture relies on its specific components working in harmony. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages serve as the foundation for hosting, providing a reliable platform to showcase your products. The backend logic powered by Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script automates the interaction with customers, ensuring swift delivery of products. Storage solutions like Supabase or Google Sheets keep order information organized, while NOWPayments processes transactions efficiently with low fees. Each component is chosen to minimize costs and maximize control, allowing you to focus on creating and selling.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To implement this architecture, start by selecting a hosting provider, either GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. Next, set up your backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script to manage orders. Choose a storage solution like Supabase or Google Sheets to keep track of transactions. For product delivery, utilize Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Finally, integrate NOWPayments for crypto transactions. For a comprehensive solution, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197), which includes all necessary blueprints and templates, streamlining your deployment process.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, utilize a combination of free tools that facilitate hosting, order management, and payment processing. By leveraging platforms like GitHub Pages for hosting, Supabase for order storage, and NOWPayments for accepting cryptocurrencies, you can create a fully functional online store. This solution circumvents the need for traditional payment processors.
Own your entire sales process without relying on third-party platforms.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Digital creators selling ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, and beats often reach this infrastructure question after hitting payout restrictions or platform policy problems on Gumroad, Payhip, or Lemon Squeezy. The difference with a sovereign stack is structural: there is no platform relationship to manage, no content policy to comply with, and no payout schedule to wait on. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys the complete infrastructure in 48 hours under your own accounts. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the build process for creators who prefer to self-deploy. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Begin by creating an account on GitHub or Cloudflare for hosting your store. Set up Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend automation. Choose Supabase or Google Sheets for tracking orders. Upload your digital products to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for delivery. Finally, integrate NOWPayments for processing crypto payments. Consider acquiring the Complete Builder Kit ($197) for all necessary resources.
